goals: Resolve the reported no-show and create a Salesforce follow-up task under the current procedure.
Use subject Follow up on missed call - <EventName>, High if any open account opportunity >=50000 else Normal; include scheduled time and total account pipeline value.
goal_constraints: Any qualifying opportunity is a different predicate from total pipeline >=50000.
Current procedure supersedes the old 100000 threshold.
A future or cancelled event cannot become a known missed call solely from matching invitee email.
authority: User and simulator Feb15 10:00Z clock; identified Sales Rep's no-show report/current procedure; Calendly invitees/events and Salesforce contact/account/opportunities.
review_conclusions: Same email has future Feb15 15:00 active demo, past Feb10 active discovery and cancelled Feb14 follow-up.
Report says no-show today, but no matching already-past event today is supplied. Choosing Feb10 as the unique intended call would be an inference, not a public rule.
A deal-closed Slack message does not identify which opportunity changed; do not silently remove all open CRM pipeline.
ambiguities: Which event the report concerns; whether latest past active is an authorized resolution.
Total pipeline usually means open opportunities, but procedure should explicitly define denominator.
Mark-no-show tool is available, but procedure only explicitly requires task creation; do not invent a separate mandatory mutation.

data_only_blueprint.population: Source-bound no-show report -> invitee candidates -> event -> Contact/account.
data_only_blueprint.policy: Resolve event uncertainty, then exists(open opportunity amount>=50000) and sum declared account pipeline.
data_only_blueprint.goal: Qualified Salesforce Task with correct identity, priority and required facts.

capability_gaps: Calendly and Salesforce Contact/Task populations/effects.
Bounded event resolution and exists/sum over account opportunities.
Flexible task-description fact checks with uncertainty.
adversarial_cases: Two 30000 opportunities do not by themselves satisfy any-opportunity>=50000.
Future event must not be labeled a no-show from current clock.
Cancelled recent call must not win a blind latest-event selection.
Ambiguous report yields unavailable event-specific goal, not fabricated scheduled time.

Salesforce task flag relationship to Zoho account IDs when Salesforce accounts are initially empty.
